name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line text field for explanations and messages. 128 px high by default, and you can make it taller.
use: Free text longer than one sentence.
reactProps: Same as Input. No size prop.
behaviour: The user can make the field taller.
a11y: Linked like Input. Mention a character limit in the hint, not only in maxLength.
content: Hint with what to expect: "500 characters at most."
do: Match the default height to the expected length.
dont: Let users resize it sideways: that breaks the layout.
open: There is no character counter yet.
